name: Grand!!
source:
Elijah Grand has just started his first year of college and he’s about to experience “real” life for the very first time. But there’s one big problem, he can’t stop seeing himself as his avatar! Now it’s up to his two best friends Lucien and Sebastian to get him up and out of his room and into the world! 

And the only way for them to do that is? A makeover! So que the 90s montage music, because Elijah is about to have the ride of his life!!

But will this help him or hurt him? 

Let’s find out!
translation:
以利亚·格兰德刚刚开始大学一年级，他即将第一次体验“真正的”生活。但有一个大问题，他无法停止将自己视为他的分身！现在，他的两个最好的朋友卢西安和塞巴斯蒂安需要把他带出房间，走向世界！

他们做到这一点的唯一方法是？改头换面！这就是90年代的蒙太奇音乐，因为Elijah即将迎来他一生的旅程！

但这对他有帮助还是有害呢？

让我们来看看吧！
